description: For every isomorphism \(e:M\to N\), infinitary formula \(\varphi\), free assignment \(a\), and scoped tuple \(b\), satisfaction in \(N\) at \((e\circ a,e\circ b)\) is equivalent to satisfaction in \(M\) at \((a,b)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_isomorphism.{u, v, w, z, z'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Finite α] {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} {N : Type z'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (e : L.Equiv M N)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ (⇑e ∘ a) (⇑e ∘ b) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a b
